messages:
Riya (sales): Hey team, Acme's sandbox POC started getting 401s this morning when calling /v1/chat. They said nothing changed client-side. Can someone look?

Acme POC (customer): We're seeing: 
```
HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
{"error":"invalid_api_key","message":"key not valid for requested org/project"}
```
Happens on both SDK and curl. No header errors in our logs. 

Evan (eng_oncall): Can you paste the sanitized request headers and which key (prefix ok)? Often a skim-key vs service-key mismatch. 

Acme POC (customer): Headers: Authorization: Bearer sk-acme-zzz, Content-Type: application/json, X-Redwood-Org: org-acme-main, X-Redwood-Project: p-42 

Nora (solutions): Did you recently rotate any keys or move projects between orgs? A signed key can be bound to a tenant. 

Evan (eng_oncall): Looking at our auth logs: validation_failed key_id=sk-acme-zzz bound_org=org-acme-sandbox request_org=org-acme-main request_project=p-42 reason=org_mismatch 

Riya (sales): So it's a binding mismatch. Acme, did infra rotate a key and accidentally use the sandbox key in prod tests? 

Acme POC (customer): Ah — we rotated keys but only updated dev. Somehow our CI picked up the old sandbox key in the staging job. We'll correct and re-run. 

Evan (eng_oncall): Quick test you can run to confirm: curl with explicit headers to match bound_org: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/chat \
 -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-acme-zzz" \
 -H "X-Redwood-Org: org-acme-sandbox" \
 -H "X-Redwood-Project: p-sandbox" \
 -d '{"model":"gpt-redwood-8k","input":"hello"}'
```
If 200, binding is the cause. 

Acme POC (customer): Ran that and got 200. Confirmed. 

Nora (solutions): Options: (1) Reissue a key with org_acme_main binding, (2) update CI to use correct key, (3) change request headers to match key (not ideal). We can generate a temp demo key scoped to org-acme-main for you. 

KeyBot: api_key.created id=dk-temp-90123 scope=org-acme-main project=p-42 expires_in=24h 

Acme POC (customer): New key works, tests green. Thanks. 

Evan (eng_oncall): Root cause: key rotation deployed incomplete config causing CI to use sandbox key. Follow-up: add clearer auth error header x-rw-auth-error=org_mismatch and doc updates. Filing ticket RW-SEC-209. 

Riya (sales): Closing on our side — Acme, ping us if you want help rolling the new key into prod. :white_check_mark:
